A Wallpaper Collection

Blooming Duo

We built these pairs for the iPhone Duo. Closed, the cover screen holds a scene at rest. Open the phone, and the inner screen blooms into the full picture, timed to the hinge as it moves.

The reveal pairs

Two moments of one scene in every pair, plus a pairing guide to walk you through setting them up. We sized them exactly for the Duo: cover 1398 x 2034, inner 2670 x 1878. Eleven pairs are in the collection now, and more join as they are finished.

For the outside of the phone

Printable iPhone Duo Skin Kit

Actual size templates for the Duo back, for the closed panel and the full open back, plus six starter designs. There is no pre-cut camera hole: the instructions walk you through a test print, tracing, and trimming, and the measured v1.1 update is free to every buyer.

Built for the hinge transition

The Duo senses its hinge angle as it opens and morphs between the cover and inner wallpapers mid unfold. We compose every pair for that exact moment. Nothing here is one picture cropped twice.

01

Closed and quiet

The cover screen shows the scene in its resting state: buds closed, one lone star, the storm still gathering.

02

The bloom

As the phone unfolds, the inner screen opens into the full scene. Same world, same light direction, two moments.

03

Crease-safe

We keep the middle of every inner image calm and low in detail, so the crease and the morph midpoint never cut through the heart of the scene.

In every pair: the cover wallpaper (1398 x 2034), the inner wallpaper (2670 x 1878), and a pairing guide. The first six pairs also include a motion loop video for a Live Photo lock screen.
